neighbours.label: Inside a direct quotation of someone's own words, as opposed to the same content reported indirectly
fire: The man yelled, “I’m going to blow up this building!”
She told reporters, “We are going to win this case.”
A caller said, “I want to cancel my subscription.”
The coach shouted, “We’re going to beat them tonight!”
The customer typed, “I need to change my flight.”
His text read, “I am going to quit tomorrow.”
The teacher asked, “What about the second question?”
One witness recalled him saying, “We’re going to take over the plane.”
quiet: The man yelled that the building was going to blow up.
She told reporters that they would probably win the case.
A caller said she wanted to cancel her subscription.
The coach shouted that the team would beat them tonight.
The customer typed that he needed to change his flight.
His text said he would quit the next day.
The teacher asked about the second question.
One witness recalled him saying that they planned to take over the plane.

predictions: Quoted versions read higher than reported ones, but probes put them only around 0.14-0.39, so this may miss the 0.20 median.
